core_categories: Pharmaceutical Wholesale; Medical Devices Distribution; Healthcare Logistics; Pharmacy Support Services; Contract Logistics; Homecare and Specialty Distribution
specialty_focus: Alliance Healthcare España is a major pharmaceutical wholesaler and healthcare logistics provider in Spain, distributing prescription drugs, medical devices, and health supplies to pharmacies and hospitals. It operates as part of Cencora and offers pharmacy support via the Alphega Pharmacy network, contract logistics under Alloga, and homecare and specialty distribution via Alcura. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Almus, Alvita, Alphega, Alcura, Alloga, Skills in Healthcare, Boots, others
